title: Validate NormalizeOr threshold contract
description: Harden the shared NumericValidity.NormalizeOr helper so its squared-magnitude threshold is itself a valid finite non-negative quantity. A negative or non-finite threshold has no meaningful squared-magnitude interpretation and previously could silently disable or distort the degenerate-vector fallback rule. Existing call sites use fixed non-negative finite thresholds, so this closes a programmer-input hole without changing valid behavior.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: NumericValidity.NormalizeOr now rejects negative and non-finite sqrMagnitudeEpsilon values. Added two focused regression tests in NumericValidityTests. Valid existing thresholds are unchanged. No Unity execution was performed in this harness.
